相关性: 该论文通过3D打印多层支架实现骨缺损修复，其机械稳定性和骨免疫微环境调控思路对生物医学增材制造方向有参考价值，但未涉及应力遮挡或植入物力学匹配。

动机· 解决动态复杂骨缺损中植入物难以稳定固定的临床挑战。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the clinical challenge of achieving stable fixation of implant materials in dynamic, non-retentive, and anatomically complex bone defects.
Method· A bioadhesive-integrated multilayer scaffold was designed and fabricated via 3D printing, comprising a soft-tissue-blocking barrier, a wet-adhesive interface, and a porous osteogenic framework.
Result· The scaffold achieved rapid and robust adhesion to bone under blood-rich conditions, significantly outperforming non-adhesive scaffolds in rabbit mandibular and tibial augmentation models, with reduced micromotion and enhanced pro-regenerative mechano-immune responses.
Validation· Validation was performed using in vivo rabbit mandibular and tibial augmentation models, comparing against non-adhesive scaffolds and a guided-bone-regeneration-like comparator.

Data-Efficient and Fast Machine Learning Molecular Dynamics through Integrated Active Learning and Knowledge Distillation

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Skim only numerical_benchmark
Xiliang Lian, Alfredo Pasquarello Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation 2026-08-21 10.1021/acs.jctc.6c00917
单位: Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) , , ,
相关性: 该论文提出的主动学习与知识蒸馏框架可显著降低机器学习势函数的训练数据需求并提升推理速度，对生物力学有限元代理模型的构建具有方法学借鉴意义。
边界: This paper focuses on molecular dynamics and interatomic potentials, not on finite element analysis, implant biomechanics, or surrogate modeling for structural mechanics.
动机· 降低机器学习势函数训练数据需求并提升推理速度。
方法· 结合DeePMD与MACE模型，采用主动学习和知识蒸馏框架。
结果· 蒸馏模型训练时间减少约10倍，数据减少25倍，精度相当。
验证· 以液态水为案例，与从头算结果对比验证精度。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To reduce the data requirements and computational cost of training machine learning interatomic potentials while maintaining high inference speed.
Method· An integrated framework combining active learning and knowledge distillation is developed, where a MACE-based foundation model is fine-tuned and then used to distill a DeePMD potential.
Result· The distilled DeePMD model achieves a 10-fold reduction in training time and a 25-fold reduction in training data compared to training from scratch, with accuracy comparable to ab initio calculations.
Validation· The approach is validated on liquid water by comparing structural, vibrational, and diffusive properties against ab initio reference data.

动机· 针对耗散型偏微分方程长时间演化求解效率低、稳定性差的问题，提出利用低维惯性流形结构。
方法· 提出惯性流形神经算子（IMNO），显式利用耗散系统的低维结构，并引入平移等变变体（IMNO-SE）以保持对称性。

Motivation· To address the challenges of accuracy and stability in long-horizon autoregressive prediction for dissipative time-dependent PDEs, this work exploits the inherent low-dimensional structure of their long-time dynamics.
Method· The authors propose the Inertial Manifold Neural Operator (IMNO), which explicitly leverages the low-dimensional inertial manifold, and a shift-equivariant variant (IMNO-SE) that enforces spatial shift symmetry in the output.
Result· Extensive numerical benchmarks demonstrate that IMNO outperforms standard FNO in terms of accuracy and stability for long-horizon predictions on nonlinear dissipative PDEs.
Validation· The method is validated through numerical benchmark experiments on several dissipative PDEs, comparing against existing neural operators.

Motivation· To reduce the feedback overhead of large antenna arrays by compressing wireless channels in a physics-aware manner.
Method· The Gramian Chebyshev Neural Operator (GCNO) identifies dominant propagation paths using channel structure, refines directions with Taylor correction, and recovers complex strengths via least squares, enabling variable-rate compression without path labels.

Motivation· Standard PINNs suffer from ill-posedness in identifying parameters of second-order oscillators because distinct parameter sets can yield nearly identical displacement records.
Method· The paper introduces D-PINN, which augments the training loss with velocity measurements, and provides theoretical guarantees via Sobolev-type inequalities, Fisher information analysis, and residual-based error bounds.
Result· Experiments on linear, forced near-resonance, and Duffing oscillators show that D-PINN reduces damping coefficient relative error from 40% to 11.7% without priors, and to 2.1% with a weak prior, a 19-fold improvement over standard PINN.
Validation· Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks on three oscillator types with multiple random seeds and extensive training epochs.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To establish the patient acceptable symptom state threshold for the Oxford Hip Score at 12 months after total hip arthroplasty and identify factors associated with not achieving it.
Method· A single-center retrospective cohort of 3997 patients was analyzed, using patient satisfaction as an anchor and ROC analysis to determine the PASS threshold, with multivariable regression to identify predictors.
Result· An OHS of 36 or higher was identified as the PASS threshold; 75.1% achieved it, and non-achievers still showed meaningful improvements and high satisfaction.
Validation· The threshold was validated using ROC analysis and multivariable logistic regression on a large clinical cohort.

Motivation· To address data leakage in preterm birth prediction from electrohysterography and establish a patient-independent benchmark.
Method· A record-grouped nested cross-validation framework with class-conditional conformal selective prediction was applied to an elastic-net logistic model on the Term-Preterm Electrohysterogram Database.
Result· Patient-independent evaluation yielded near-chance performance (AUROC 0.493), with conformal prediction abstaining on 72.7% of cases at 10% miscoverage.
Validation· Validation used record-grouped nested cross-validation with bootstrap resampling and coverage assessment on a public clinical database.

Motivation· To evaluate the accuracy and clinical feasibility of robot-assisted implant placement in edentulous jaws.
Method· A retrospective case series of 15 edentulous patients (128 implants) was analyzed, measuring implant deviations via CBCT superimposition and recording insertion torque, operative time, and follow-up outcomes.
Result· Mean linear deviations were 0.71 mm at the neck and 0.74 mm at the apex, with a mean angular deviation of 1.16°; all implants achieved 100% survival with successful osseointegration.

Motivation· The study aims to clarify the relationship between ambient-pressure and high-pressure superconductivity in bilayer nickelate films.
Method· Systematic experiments on compressively strained La2LnNi2O7 films under high pressure and with lanthanide substitution were conducted.
Result· Tc was enhanced to 67-73 K at 16 GPa, while chemical pressure reduced Tc, correlating with normal-state transport behavior.
Validation· Validation involved high-field resistivity measurements and high-pressure experiments in a cubic-anvil cell.

Motivation· To reduce the annotation cost of training query-propagation multi-object tracking models by selecting informative video clips for annotation.
Method· Proposes QPID, which perturbs internal track states to measure association instability and combines uncertainty-weighted visual coverage for diverse batch selection.
Result· QPID achieves competitive tracking performance on DanceTrack and SportsMOT under the same annotation budget compared to active learning baselines.
Validation· Validated through experiments on two public MOT benchmarks with two different query-propagation trackers.
